solution_text:
1. Cast Metallic Mimic, naming "Servo".
1a. Trespasser's Curse triggers twice. When it resolves, you will have dropped to 5, and your opponent has come up to 4.
1b. Olivia triggers twice. Ignore one of them, and discard a Swamp to make the Mimic a 3/2 haste Servo Vampire Shapeshifter (oh my.)
1c. Putting the counter on the Mimic triggers Animation Module. Choose to pay 1 to make a 1/1 Servo, which enters the battlefield as a 2/2 thanks to Metallic Mimic.
2. We're finally at 2! Go lie down for a bit.
3. With a 3/3, 3/2, 4/4, and 5/5, all able to attack, attacking with all looks pretty good.
3a. Now your hand is empty, so Bloodhall Priest's ability triggers. Ping the opponent for 2, bringing them to 6.
3b. They have only two blockers, so their best block lets 6 through for lethal.
